name: remote-ios-deploy
description: Build, install and verify signed apps on an already-paired remote iPhone from a Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy signed apps to a paired remote iPhone from your Mac.
interface.longDescription: A local macOS development workflow for explicit Bonjour and TCP/UDP bridging, fresh Xcode builds, signing checks and sustained startup verification. Requires compatible Xcode, Python 3, socat, valid signing and existing Mac-phone pairing. Cross-network Wi-Fi installation was verified; direct cellular deployment and remote first-time pairing are not supported as validated workflows. Requires local application and hardware access; not a cloud-only deployment service.
defaultPrompt: Deploy my current project to my paired remote iPhone.
Explain first-time setup for a new phone or deployment Mac.
Diagnose a remote iPhone deployment connection failure.
